stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Stacey's Smart Team has been laid to rest (5.76 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🔁 Trade that should have happened: LaPorta and Strange ↔ Tate and Herbert back in Week 1 would have helped both sides.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Team Name leads the chopping-block odds at 24%, with In My Fantasy Era next at 19%.
🤝 Rivalry week: The Mahomies leads TDsMaGee 5–3 all-time, and The Mahomies has won the last 2.
🥊 Heavyweight bout: #1 Brock You Like a Hurricane (4–0) meets #3 Gibb it to Me Baby (3–1).
🤝 Rivalry week: Ruffing the Passer leads Kyle Tucker 6–1 all-time, and Ruffing the Passer has won the last 3.
🪑 The one that got away (on the bench): TDsMaGee has yet to start RJ Harvey. Starting him in Weeks 1, 3 and 4 would have meant 2 more wins by now (+18.10 pts).
🏈 6 matchups are still up for grabs, and TDsMaGee vs The Mahomies (TDsMaGee 60%) is the tightest.
🎲 Ramosverse is rolling with 3 TEs (McBride, Ferguson and Hockenson) and just 2 healthy RBs. It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
📰 Sources: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson dealing with ankle sprain. That's Mr. Action Jackson's starting QB. Developing.
📈 TRENDING: Keon Coleman (WR, BUF) was added 2.6M times on Sleeper in a day. Nobody here has him.
🤔 What could have been: If Ramosverse and 49er Faith-Fool had swapped Washington and McBride for Brown and Swift back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
